# PR #3614: Patch: an AI seat can open with fewer cards and skip turn draws (two new handicap settings)

Closes #3582

## What changed

A `Handicap` takes two new optional fields. Ruling **R3582000** covers both, and only the dungeon run's early enemies will set them, in a later part of #3581.

- **`fewerOpeningCards`** (`fewer_opening_cards`) takes cards off a seat's opening draw. The draw is §2.1's entry, plus `extraOpeningCards`, minus this field, and never drops below `MIN_OPENING_HAND` (1).
  - The only code change is in `setup::opening_hand_size`. The deal, Quickdraw and the mulligan already read that function, so they follow with nothing else changed.
- **`drawEvery`** (`draw_every`) n means the seat takes its start-of-turn draws (R183's `DRAWS_PER_TURN` + `extraDrawsPerTurn`) only on its own turns whose `turns_started` is a multiple of n. With 2, that is its 2nd, 4th and 6th turns.
  - On any other turn, `turn::start_of_turn_draw` draws 0 cards. That means no card, no fatigue step and no cast on draw. A card's own "draw" still draws.
  - `state::takes_turn_draws` holds the check. It floors the divisor at `DRAW_EVERY_TURN`, so a state built without validation can't divide by zero.
- **Refusals.** `validate_handicap` refuses `fewerOpeningCards < 0` and `drawEvery < 1`. The message names the seat, the field and R3582000, in the style of `heroArmor`'s.
- **No change to existing games.** An absent field, `fewerOpeningCards: 0` and `drawEvery: 1` are neither serialized nor stored, because `is_human_handicap` and the stored copy in `build_game` filter them out. So every existing game, practice tier, lesson, golden trace and fuzz seed stores and hashes exactly as before.
  - `HUMAN_HANDICAP`, the tiers and `AI_TUTORIAL` gain the two `None`s. No other literal in the workspace needed them; the rest already use `..`.
- **Wire types.** `apps/web/src/wire/generated/Handicap.ts` was regenerated with `fewerOpeningCards?` and `drawEvery?`. `engineConfig.ts` did not change.
- **Spec.** I added `spec/rulings/R3582000.md` and `spec/pending/3582.md`.

Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

The dungeon run's early enemies must be weaker than the Easy AI (the tiers part of the tracker #3581). Today a seat's `Handicap` (`crates/engine/src/config.rs`, R180) can make a seat weaker only through its mana cap, its hero's health (R290) or its deck size (R184). `validate_handicap` (`crates/engine/src/state.rs`) refuses any negative field, so a seat cannot open with fewer cards than §2.1 deals (R182), nor draw less at the start of its turns (R183).

Add two optional fields to `Handicap`. Each is absent by default and left out of the stored and serialized handicap when absent, exactly as `hero_health`, `hero_armor` and `deck_copies` are (`#[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]`, `ts(optional)`):

- **`fewer_opening_cards: Option<i32>`** (JSON `fewerOpeningCards`): the cards taken off this seat's opening draw. - **`draw_every: Option<i32>`** (JSON `drawEvery`): the seat takes its start-of-turn draws (R183's `DRAWS_PER_TURN` + `extraDrawsPerTurn`) on only one of every n of its own turns. `1` means every turn, as today. The ruling says which turns draw, for example the seat's 2nd, 4th and so on, or its 1st, 3rd and so on. A card or effect that says "draw" still draws.

`createGame` refuses `fewerOpeningCards` below 0 and `drawEvery` below 1, each with a reason in the style of `validate_handicap`'s others. A seat whose handicap omits both stores, hashes and replays exactly as before (`is_human_handicap`, `HANDICAP_FIELDS`, the stored copy in `state.rs`'s setup). The practice tiers (`AI_DIFFICULTY`), the tutorial (`AI_TUTORIAL`, `TUTORIAL_HUMAN`), Duos and the ladder set neither. Only the dungeon run will, in a later part of #3581.

The Handicap literals across the workspace (`crates/engine`, `crates/ai`, `crates/shared`, `crates/cards`' tests, `crates/run`, `crates/tools`) gain the two `None`s, or use `..HUMAN_HANDICAP`.
